policy: Groups contain items that share the same user task after human inspection. Shared constraint templates with different user requests are not grouped. Items absent from these groups are unknown; this file does not claim training-data isolation or that all related tasks were found.

groups.rationale: Same only-child user request (solitary birthdays, parental bonds, family expectations; question about how being an only child shapes relationships). Constraints differ: emoji at the end of every sentence vs nested parentheses.

Same axisymmetric continuity-equation proof (governing scalar equations, ∂(yu)/∂x + ∂(yv)/∂y = 0, prove step by step). Constraints differ: trigram overlap vs balanced sentence types plus consonant clusters.

Same dissertation question on evolving scam tactics in the digital age. One item asks how to gather sources; the other asks for a literature review with citations. The unique question text is identical, so putting one in dev and one in test would leak the task.
Identical user query 'What animal is the national symbol of the US?'. Constraints differ only by reversing the sentence per letter vs per word.
